description:
Morphe patch bundle for X (com.twitter.android), built from the pinned Piko commit recorded in morphe/build.sh, plus the Twitter Bookmarker overlay in morphe/overlay/.

Add this repository as a patch source in Morphe Manager, then select **Save to Twitter Bookmarker**. This bundle already contains every Piko patch, so Piko's own release does not need to be added as well.

The overlay is GPLv3: see morphe/LICENSE and morphe/NOTICE.

Changes the package name and the app name. This allows you to install the patched app alongside the original Instagram app.
Caution: Do not select the official Morphe's "Change package name" universal patch.
